protocol.description: This is a private Gamescope protocol for sending input events. No stable ABI is guaranteed for this protocol, it is versioned with gamescope.

request.name: keyboard_key
request.description: Send a keyboard key event to gamescope. The 'key' is a Linux scan code (EV_MSC/MSC_SCAN), not a keycode. Use 0 for release, 1 for press.

request.name: mouse_motion

description.summary: send a relative mouse motion event

request.description: Move the mouse by the given delta (dx, dy) in pixels. Positive dx is right, positive dy is down.

request.name: mouse_warp
request.description: Warp the mouse cursor to the given absolute position (x, y). Coordinates are in the gamescope virtual output space. The maximum coordinates are given by the width/height from the get_output_size event.

request.name: mouse_button
request.description: Send a mouse button press or release event. The 'button' is a Linux input event code for mouse

request.name: mouse_scroll
request.description: Send a scroll event. Positive is scroll up/right. Values are in 120-per-notch scaling: value * 120 -> 120 = 1.0 notch.

request.name: get_output_size
request.description: Query the gamescope output size in pixels for absolute positioning calculations. The size will be sent back via the output_size event.

event.name: output_size
event.description: Reply to get_output_size with the current output dimensions. This is the virtual output size, not the physical display size.

request.name: get_mouse_position
request.description: Query the current mouse cursor position. The position will be sent back via the mouse_position event.

event.name: mouse_position
event.description: Reply to get_mouse_position with the current cursor position. Position is in the gamescope virtual output space.
